name: Past Kurou
source:
Kurou's previous incarnation.
[spoiler]He befriended the twin brother of Futaba's previous incarnation. Past Kurou told the brother that he shouldn't hang around a "monster" like himself, only for the brother to embrace him and say he didn't have to be all by himself. Past Kurou then made a contract with the brother.[/spoiler]
